answer: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data f WHERE f.uuid=c.uuid AND f.language='French') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM cards c WHERE c.isStorySpotlight=1
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE duelDeck='a'
SELECT 100.0*SUM(cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL)/COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE setCode=(SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name='Coldsnap')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) FROM cards c WHERE c.isPromo=1 AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%' AND c.supertypes LIKE '%Legendary%' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legalities l JOIN cards d ON d.uuid=l.uuid WHERE d.name=c.name AND l.format='brawl' AND l.status='Legal')
SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))-MIN(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) FROM cards WHERE name='Tarmogoyf' AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE frameVersion=(SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) FROM cards WHERE convertedManaCost=0 AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*') GROUP BY frameVersion

SELECT s.name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND c.convertedManaCost<=3)/COUNT(*),2) FROM sets s JOIN cards c ON c.setCode=s.code WHERE s.code IN ((SELECT s2.code FROM sets s2 WHERE s2.code IN (SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name='Abyssal Horror') ORDER BY s2.releaseDate, s2.code LIMIT 1),(SELECT code FROM sets ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code LIMIT 1)) GROUP BY s.code ORDER BY s.releaseDate

SELECT DISTINCT name FROM cards WHERE setCode='DKA' AND ','||keywords||',' LIKE '%,Flash,%' AND convertedManaCost=(SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM cards WHERE setCode='DKA' AND ','||keywords||',' LIKE '%,Flash,%') ORDER BY name

SELECT s.name, s.keyruneCode, COUNT(DISTINCT t.language) FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations t ON t.setCode=s.code AND t.translation IS NOT NULL AND t.translation<>'' WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY s.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM sets s WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM set_translations t WHERE t.setCode=s.code AND t.language<>'English' AND t.translation<>'')) OR setCode IN (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE parentCode IN (SELECT code FROM sets s WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM set_translations t WHERE t.setCode=s.code AND t.language<>'English' AND t.translation<>'')))

SELECT s.type, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM set_translations t WHERE t.setCode=s.code AND t.language='Japanese' AND t.translation IS NOT NULL AND t.translation<>'')) FROM sets s GROUP BY s.type ORDER BY s.type

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE releaseDate=(SELECT MAX(s.releaseDate) FROM sets s WHERE s.code IN (SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name="Ancestor's Chosen")) AND code IN (SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name="Ancestor's Chosen")) AND types LIKE '%Creature%' AND power GLOB '[0-9]*' AND toughness GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(power AS REAL)>CAST(toughness AS REAL)
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM cards WHERE isPromo=1 AND originalReleaseDate LIKE '2019/%' AND otherFaceIds IS NOT NULL AND otherFaceIds<>''
SELECT SUM(convertedManaCost) FROM cards WHERE artist='Rob Alexander' AND originalReleaseDate LIKE '2013/%'
